## mcrl notification-group create

Create a notification group.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl notification-group create [flags]

Aliases:
  create, new

Create a notification group from flags, or from a JSON or YAML file in the API's format
with -f. Flags override the file's fields.

API: POST /api/v0/notification-groups
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl ng create --name web-oncall --level critical --channel ops-slack --service web
  mcrl ng create -f group.yaml

Flags:
      --channel stringArray        notification channel, ID or name (repeatable; replaces the list)
      --child-group stringArray    child notification group, ID or name (repeatable; replaces the list)
  -f, --file string                JSON or YAML file in the API's format ("-" for stdin)
      --level string               notification level: all or critical
      --monitor stringArray        monitor, ID or name (repeatable; replaces the list)
      --monitor-only stringArray   monitor whose alerts go only to this group (skipDefault), ID or name (repeatable)
      --name string                name
      --service stringArray        service (repeatable; replaces the list)
```

## mcrl notification-group delete

Delete a notification group.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl notification-group delete <notification-group>

Aliases:
  delete, rm

Delete a notification group. The output is the deleted object.

API: DELETE /api/v0/notification-groups/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl ng delete web-oncall
  mcrl ng delete 2wvKpqFzgD9 --yes
```

## mcrl notification-group edit

Edit a notification group in $EDITOR.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl notification-group edit <notification-group>

Open the current notification group as YAML in $VISUAL or $EDITOR (default vi), then
show the changes and send them after confirmation.

The whole object is sent back, including fields mcrl does not know about,
so nothing is lost. Read-only fields (id, type) are hidden. If the file does not
parse, the editor opens again with the error at the top. Saving an empty file
or leaving it unchanged cancels.

API: PUT /api/v0/notification-groups/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl notification-group edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
  EDITOR='code --wait' mcrl notification-group edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
```

## mcrl notification-group get

Show a notification group.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl notification-group get <notification-group>

Aliases:
  get, show

Show a notification group by ID or name.

A reference that looks like an ID (11 alphanumeric characters) is looked up
as an ID first. Prefix it with "id:" or "name:" to force either.

API: GET /api/v0/notification-groups
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl ng get Default
  mcrl ng get 2wvKpqFzgD9
```

## mcrl notification-group list

```text
Usage:

Aliases:
  list, ls

List notification groups.

API: GET /api/v0/notification-groups
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl notification-group list
  mcrl ng list --jq '.[].name'
```

## mcrl notification-group update

Update a notification group.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl notification-group update <notification-group> [flags]

Update a notification group. The current notification group is fetched and the flags (and -f fields) are
applied on top, so only the fields to change need to be given. --replace
sends the -f file as the complete object instead.

API: PUT /api/v0/notification-groups/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl ng update web-oncall --channel ops-slack --channel oncall-email
  mcrl ng update web-oncall --monitor-only 'cpu high'

Flags:
      --channel stringArray        notification channel, ID or name (repeatable; replaces the list)
      --child-group stringArray    child notification group, ID or name (repeatable; replaces the list)
  -f, --file string                JSON or YAML file with the fields to change ("-" for stdin)
      --level string               notification level: all or critical
      --monitor stringArray        monitor, ID or name (repeatable; replaces the list)
      --monitor-only stringArray   monitor whose alerts go only to this group (skipDefault), ID or name (repeatable)
      --name string                name
      --replace[=true|false]       send the -f file as the complete object without merging
      --service stringArray        service (repeatable; replaces the list)
```
